title: Travel Completed | APPR | Controllable | Delay 6�<9 hrs | AC Wallet (20%) | Elite 50 K Profile
description:
Validates Tier 2 flight disruption compensation for an Aeroplan Elite 50K (Star Alliance Gold) member where the customer selects AC Wallet payout. A 7-hour controllable delay on a single domestic leg (Flight AC 431, YUL?YYZ) falls within the APPR 6�<9hr delay band. The linked active Aeroplan Elite 50K profile triggers the APPR dual payment offer, and the customer selects AC Wallet. Validates that the 20% top-up calculation is accurately applied on the Tier 2 statutory base ($700 CAD base + 20% top-up = $840 CAD AC Wallet). Confirms that DDS returns EL-02, Persona IDV passes, CyberSource returns GREEN, the compensation record routes to EIP/iFly (not Unifier), and the Claims Dashboard reflects Elite 50K tier status with read-only resolution.
